theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U E K : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → MeasurableSet E → IsCompact K → E ⊆ K → K ⊆ U → ∃ (Q : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (RQ : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (T₁ : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R₁ : IMRep U n), RQ.Represents Q ∧ RQ.measure = R.measure.restrict E ∧ R₁.Represents T₁ ∧ R₁.measure = R.measure.restrict Eᶜ ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = Q (testFormOnInclusion (subset_univ U) n ω) + T₁ ω) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ E → Q (testFormOnInclusion (subset_univ U) n ω) = T ω) ∧ Q.support ⊆ closure E ∩ T.support ∧ IsCompact Q.support
